correctness.rationale: Direct size-r product weighting gives p_i=lambda_i e_{r-1}(lambda_-i)/e_r(lambda), sum p_i=r. Difference p_j-p_i=(lambda_j-lambda_i)e_{r-1}(other)/e_r gives order. With min lambda=1, the ratio e_r(rest)/e_{r-1}(rest) is nondecreasing in each positive variable by Newton inequalities; its maximum when all others K gives p_min=r/[r+(d-r)K]. For the ratio p_max/p_min, fixing h=lambda_max gives h(s+1)/(s+h) with s=e_{r-1}(middle)/e_{r-2}(middle), maximized as middle coordinates equal h; the final h maximum is K, giving (r-1+(d-r)K)/(d-1). Check all boundaries r=1,r=d,K=1 and strict equality cases. Exact independent subset enumeration checked 24,912 bounded integer-spectrum/dimension/block cases, both bounds and attainment; this corroborates but does not replace the symbolic monotonicity proof.
